title: Own line vs the officially sourced posted line, on a weekly schedule

schedule.cadence: one row per (game, market) per week, written when the week is graded
schedule.from_day_one: the schedule starts with week 1; weeks without an official posted line are published as blank, never interpolated

interpretation: residual = model fair line minus the official posted line. It is a market-divergence measurement. It is NOT CLV and NOT an edge: the posted line's capture time is unpublished, so this build cannot show that the line preceded kickoff.

sign_convention.SIDE: positive means the model likes the home team by more than the posted home-margin line
sign_convention.TOTAL: positive means the model's fair total is above the posted total
sign_convention.MONEYLINE: model fair American price for the home side minus the posted one; positive means the model prices the home side shorter (more likely)
